name: The Medicine Woman
source:
William is still reeling from Tarni leaving him high and dry. He has been suffering nocturnal lusts and decides enough is enough. He goes to see the Medicine Woman… Will she cure his ailments? There is always a price…

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/the-medicine-woman.html]Affect3D[/url]]
translation:
威廉仍因塔尔妮离开而痛苦，持续遭受夜间性欲折磨，终于决定不能再这样下去。他前往拜访药剂师……她能治好他的病吗？一切总有代价……
